findings.claim: The candidate still lacks the native execution evidence required to satisfy the phase acceptance criteria, so it cannot be accepted or release-certified at the current head.
findings.evidence: Acceptance tasks 4.3 and 4.6 remain unchecked, the packet known_state says the final current-head matrix is still running, and lines 69-74 explicitly leave the GitHub Actions run, Windows x64/ARM64 execution, Android/iOS relaunch persistence, and final review pending.
findings.suggested_fix: Wait for the committed current-head matrix, require every native job to pass, record the immutable run URL and per-target receipts, then rerun this final adversarial review against that exact commit.

findings.claim: A copied-harness install that selects an external --source or --ref silently mixes that source's skills with prompts, plugins, activation metadata, and the native CLI from the installer's local package revision.
findings.evidence: Lines 151-179 resolve and validate portableRoot and lines 208-217 copy skills from it, but lines 261-270 copy Codex/OpenCode resources from packageRoot and lines 305-311 build and copy the CLI from packageRoot; matching only package id/version at lines 176-178 does not prove byte or revision identity.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve every source-controlled resource and the CLI manifest from portableRoot, or reject external sources for modes that cannot honor them; add a test using two same-version payloads with different adapter/CLI bytes and a pinned ref.

findings.claim: The --status value bypasses both secret detection and repository-path redaction even though it is persisted to the public/private wiki records and event logs.
findings.evidence: Line 12 builds the secret-scanned text from title, summary, evidence, and next only, and lines 35-37 redact paths from those same four fields only; status is accepted as arbitrary text at lines 7-10 and is written into content and event payloads at lines 41-44.
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict status to a documented slug/enum, or include it in the same secret scan and path-redaction pipeline before constructing either record.
